'''Xiao-Fan Wang''' ({{zh|s=王小凡|t=|p=Wāng Xiǎofán}}; born 1955) is a [[Chinese-American]] [[oncologist]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2011/7/249792.shtm |script-title=zh:美国杜克大学教授王小凡：国家医学教育已到危机关头 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=2011-07-20 |language=zh}}</ref> He is the Donald and Elizabeth Cooke Professor of Cancer Research at [[Duke University School of Medicine]].

==Biography==
Wang was born in [[Ürümqi]], [[Xinjiang]], [[China]] in 1955. His family moved to a village in [[Henan]] province in the 1970s, during the [[Cultural Revolution]], his mother was imprisoned by local government for "historical questions". Wang was raised by his paternal grandmother. Before graduating from primary school, he was assigned to work as a worker in a factory for 8 years.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn//htmlnews/2010/3/229502.shtm |script-title=zh:王小凡：我会为祖国科教事业做更多 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=2010-03-16 |language=zh}}</ref> After resuming the college entrance examination, he entered [[Wuhan University]], majoring in biochemistry, where he graduated in 1982. After college, he was accepted to the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], he attended the China-United States Biochemistry Examination and Application (CUSBEA) and was sent abroad to study at the expense of the Chinese government with his wife [[Xinnian Dong]]. Wang earned his doctor's degree in biology from the [[University of California, Los Angeles]] in 1986. He did post-doctoral research at the [[Whitehead Institute|Whitehead Institute for Biomedical Research]], [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] from 1987 to 1992 under Professor [[Robert Weinberg (biologist)|Robert Weinberg]].

Wang has taught at [[Duke University]] since 1992. He was promoted to associate professor in 1992 and to full Professor in 2003.

Wang was elected as a foreign academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] on November 28, 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cas.cn/tt/201711/t20171128_4624789.shtml|title=关于公布2017年中国科学院院士增选当选院士名单的公告|date=2017-11-28|publisher=Chinese Academy of Sciences |language=zh |access-date=2019-11-22}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Wang's father-in-law, Dong Fureng ({{zh|s=董辅礽|links=no}}; 1927-2004), was a Chinese-American economist. His mother-in-law, Liu Ainian ({{zh|s=刘蔼年|links=no}}), is a Chinese-American ophthalmologist. His wife, [[Xinnian Dong]] ({{zh|s=董欣年|links=no}}), is a professor at [[Duke University]] and an academician of the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] and [[National Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.sohu.com/a/207865345_355701 |script-title=zh:王小凡和董欣年：中美院士伉俪竟是武大同学 |work=Sohu |date=2017-12-01 |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.bio.whu.edu.cn/index.php/View/2619.html |script-title=zh:杰出校友王小凡、董欣年教授重回母校 |work=whu.edu.cn |date=2018-06-13 |language=zh }}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
